pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Configure model rules, dimensional rates, and service-tier ladders.

defaults.title: Load default prices
defaults.description: Select models from the default catalog. Existing rules with the same model pattern are skipped; their prices stay unchanged.
defaults.empty: No models with default prices match.
defaults.loadError: Could not load default prices. Retry.
defaults.saveError: Could not import default prices. Retry.

rules.saveError: Could not save the price rule. Retry.
rules.empty: No price rules. Add one before traffic can settle at a non-zero cost.
rules.selectPrompt: Select a price rule to inspect its dimensional rates.

tiers.title: Prompt and service tiers
tiers.contextDescription: Overrides base rates at the highest prompt-token threshold reached, without selecting a service tier.
tiers.contextEmptyDescription: Base rates apply at every context length.
tiers.serviceDescription: Each service tier has its own context ladder.
tiers.serviceEmptyDescription: Tiers reported by requests and responses use the base rates.
tiers.serviceGroupDescription: Settlement matches the tier first, then the highest context threshold reached inside that tier.
tiers.contextBandDescription: Overrides base rates after this threshold is reached.
tiers.serviceBandDescription: Rates for this service tier in this context range.
tiers.contextThresholdHint: Required. Settlement selects the highest step not above actual prompt tokens.
tiers.serviceThresholdHint: Use 0 for every context length, then add higher thresholds for long-context pricing.
tiers.multiplierHint: When a category has no explicit price, this composes with the base context ladder.
tiers.explicitPricesHint: Explicit prices win over the multiplier. Repeat them at each long-context threshold they cover.

warning.title: Long-context price step is missing
warning.longContext: This explicit service-tier price replaces the base ladder, but the base ladder has a higher threshold. Add the matching service-tier threshold row or use a multiplier.

rates.title: Dimensional rates
rates.saveError: Could not save the rate. Retry.
rates.deleteError: Could not delete the rate. Retry.
rates.empty: No dimensional rates for this rule.
